title: Red Hat Security Advisory: grafana security update
description: Two denial of service vulnerabilities were identified in Grafana, an open source metrics dashboard and graph editor. The first vulnerability (CVE-2026-8609) involves unbounded memory growth in the OAuth login route. The second (CVE-2026-33382) involves excessive memory allocation from large API request payloads. These issues could cause Grafana to consume excessive memory, potentially leading to service disruption. Red Hat has issued a security update for Grafana in Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9 to address these vulnerabilities.
